scope: Implement only the adopted separately versioned current-host provider, JavaScript probe, safe preparer, original-test setup and explicit isolated-driver bindings; independent source review and focused non-qualifying controls
acceptance: Confirmed early recovery before substantial work
Source-bound new implementation and exact preserved original method/helper and JS scientific bodies
Frozen independent control expectations before focused isolated filesystem and mocked process-boundary execution; no claims of actual host qualification
Independent review resolves mandatory findings or identifies concrete blocker
Required documentary and focused tool checks; conditional retained-branch publication; verified saved partial ZIP and matching prompts with separate receipt
stop: At independently reviewed implementation evidence or first concrete blocker/unplanned expansion, finish partial delivery and stop. No second phase.
constraints: No Node/ldd execution or actual runtime installation/qualification in P06; those require later Gate H
No full required routine, main lease/integration, native/model trials or hosted CI
Preserve every historical failure/source pin/dependency byte, original test/helper body and source 100000-operation/30000-ms limits
Keep original seven methods; missing config is visible failure, never skip
No nested worker fanout; root alone canonical Git/index/publication/delivery

workers./root/live_state_review: Independent intake, frozen controls and exact candidate review
workers./root/provider_impl: Python provider, safe preparer and original test lifecycle binding
workers./root/package_builder: Early/final packages; independent argv reading and disjoint JavaScript probe

approval_channel_resolution: Explicitly bound --expected-config-sha256 DIGEST before terminal --job FILE; permitted schema/bootstrap adaptation, external expected digest cannot originate solely in manifest
candidate_disposition: Implementation drafted; independent focused controls and combined review pending
